trial_identity_breed_overlap.read_only_query: SELECT en.identity_status, en.breed_status, COUNT(*) FROM entry en JOIN event ev ON ev.id=en.event_id WHERE ev.event_type='trial' AND ev.meet=2 GROUP BY en.identity_status,en.breed_status ORDER BY en.identity_status,en.breed_status;
trial_identity_breed_overlap.interpretation: The 14 breed-unconfirmed rows are a subset of the 55 identity-unresolved rows. The dimensions overlap and must not be summed as disjoint categories.

rank_prefix_breed_evidence_review.finding: All 92,208 rows in the existing 9,423-race result layer are marked native_confirmed solely with breed_evidence=official_result_rank_explicit_je. This establishes the implementation rule, not its biological validity. The current API4_3 field semantics need direct documentation; the KRA roster API calls its own rank field racehorse grade, and a separate standings API provides blood codes (1 제주마, 2 재래마, 3 한라마). Treat the existing rank-derived breed labels as provisional pending a full re-audit against explicit horse ID/profile or blood evidence.
rank_prefix_breed_evidence_review.next_evidence_for_canonical_breed: Join official horse ID to event-time KRA profile/blood evidence; preserve unknown or conflicting records as unresolved.
rank_prefix_breed_evidence_review.official_detailed_result_dataset_note: 15089492 documents the separate racedetailresult/getracedetailresult service, not the current API4_3/raceResult_3 endpoint. Its field list omits breed, but it is not direct schema evidence for API4_3.
rank_prefix_breed_evidence_review.official_roster_rank_definition_note: The separate KRA racehorse roster API describes its rank field as racehorse grade; matching semantics to API4_3 is an inference because the API4_3 schema was not available in this retry.
